constants.M_R_RECON_interpretation: M_R^eff = m_e is an effective See-Saw scale chosen so that m_Dirac^2 / M_R^eff reproduces Theorem 9.1's phi^(-36) law; it is distinct from the E_6 GUT scale M_E_6 = M_red * phi^(-9) ~ 3.2e16 GeV (Tier 3, conditional on O.15). The 2x2 agreement is an algebraic identity given that choice.

closure_status.tier: Tier 3: consistency arithmetic with a chosen effective scale (M_R^eff = m_e); not an independent verification
closure_status.claim: With M_R^eff = m_e chosen to match, the 2x2 See-Saw light eigenvalue equals m_e * phi^(-36) identically, and it survives a subdominant itinerant hopping (t = m_e * phi^(-42), chosen below the See-Saw eigenvalue) on a 12-vertex (A_g sector of H_3) lattice. With the E_6 GUT scale (Theorem 9.2) the See-Saw term is ~20 orders of magnitude smaller. The effective scale is not derived from the lattice.
closure_status.what_is_NOT_closed: Full 6D non-perturbative lattice simulation with all H_3 irreps (Protocol G full HPC). The icosahedrally-reduced 12-vertex sector confirms the A_g (totally-symmetric) mode scaling; sub-leading irreps (T_1u, T_2u, etc) and oscillation parameter (PMNS) extraction require the full HPC calculation.
closure_status.scope_note: H.2.3 is open: the reduced-sector checks are consistency arithmetic given the chosen effective scale; a lattice derivation of that scale and full HPC closure (all icosahedral irreps + thermal disorder + oscillation parameters) remain research-level.
